title: An animation player
description:
Play animations with frame times, looping or stopping at the end.

```
walk (loop, 4 frames x 0.1 s): t=0.25 -> frame 2
attack (once, 3 frames x 0.05 s): t=0.2 -> frame 2, finished
switch from walk to attack -> starts at frame 0
```
hints: `int n{static_cast<int>(m_time / a.secondsPerFrame)};` then `loop ? n % count : std::min(n, count - 1)` (lesson 2.02).
Compare animation names (or pointers) in `play` to decide whether to restart.
requirements: An `Animation` has a first frame, a frame count, seconds per frame and a loop flag.
`Player::update(dt)` advances the time; `frame()` gives the current frame.
Starting the same animation again does not restart it; a different one does.
stretch: Fire an event on a chosen frame (the sword hits on frame 1).
